# awscc_quicksight_brand (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::QuickSight::Brand



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the brand.
- `aws_account_id` (String) The ID of the Amazon Web Services account that owns the brand.
- `brand_definition` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--brand_definition))
- `brand_id` (String) The ID of the QuickSight brand.
- `brand_status` (String) The status of the brand.
- `created_time` (String) The time that the brand was created.
- `last_updated_time` (String) The last time the brand was updated.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags for the brand. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `version_id` (String) The ID of the version.
- `version_status` (String) The status of the version.
